input:
If variance of x₁, x₂, ......, xₙ is σ_x², then the variance of λx₁, λx₂, ......, λxₙ(λ ≠ 0) is

Options:
A. λ · σ_x
B. λ · σ_x²
C. λ² · σ_x
D. λ² · σ_x²

phase_1_understand_the_problem.problem_restatement: Find the variance of a dataset after multiplying every data point xᵢ by a non-zero scalar λ.
phase_1_understand_the_problem.key_observation: When each value in a dataset is multiplied by a constant λ, the variance is multiplied by λ².

key_concepts: Property of variance under linear transformation: Var(aX + b) = a² Var(X)

phase_3_plan_the_approach.strategy: Apply the scaling property of variance Var(λX) = λ² Var(X) directly.
logical_steps: Step 2: Apply scaling property Var(λX) = λ² Var(X)
Step 3: Conclude new variance is λ² · σ_x²

step_2_scaled_data.new_variance: Var(λX) = (1/n) ∑ (λxᵢ - λx̄)² = λ² · (1/n) ∑ (xᵢ - x̄)² = λ² σ_x²

phase_5_verify_answer.verification: Var(λX) = λ² Var(X) = λ² σ_x² is a standard statistical property ✓
